name: Venezuela
pending: Citgo sale pending at OFAC (State against Treasury, Commerce, Energy). No election date: State wants a new Supreme Court and electoral council first, best case June 2027; talks Nov 11-15. US official: Rodríguez should declare a vacancy in 2027; Machado proposes Jul 24, 2027. Oil money held in a Treasury-controlled account; some sanctions suspended, reversible (Oct 26). Jorge Rodríguez delisted (Oct 14). Rubio: Alex Saab extradited and cooperating. First 1M barrels in Corpus Christi (White House claim, Oct 27). Southern Vanguard exercise in Colombia Oct 27-Nov 11; boat strike killed five (Oct 28). Rubio and Bessent met FM Oliver Blanco (Nov 2); Treasury readout: a three-phase plan (stabilization, recovery, transition), energy, reconnecting the financial sector.
